CashMachineProcessingRate.definition: Processing rate of a cash-based machine in people per hour

CardMachineProcessingRate.definition: Processing rate of a card-only machine in people per hour

CashMachinePaperRolls.definition: Number of paper rolls used per hour by a cash-based machine

CardMachinePaperRolls.definition: Number of paper rolls used per hour by a card-only machine

MinPeopleProcessed.definition: Minimum number of people that must be processed per hour

MaxPaperRolls.definition: Maximum number of paper rolls that can be used per hour
